draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Delhi to Ludhiana Route
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Delhi to Ludhiana Route

Dear Orion Pharma Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown of vehicle DL33CT2113, a replacement unit (DL82GO5198) has been dispatched from our Delhi hub.
The new vehicle is currently en route to Ludhiana with an estimated arrival time of approximately 9.3 hours.
We are monitoring the shipment closely to ensure minimal disruption to your delivery schedule.
Please let us know if you require any further updates.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
